data.name: Pierrette
data.gender_notes: Pierrette is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Diminutive form of Pierre, meaning rock or stone. In Christian tradition, Pierrette is a name for those who value the pearl of great price. The name Pierrette carries the meaning “Little Pearl” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Pierrette usually hope their child will grow to embody little pearl and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Pierrette belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Pearl.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pierrette total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: Pierrette is a name with French origins, commonly given to French Canadian women. It's a diminutive form of Pierre, and its cultural significance is one of strength, as Pierre means rock or stone. This name has been popularized in various French Canadian communities and has been passed down through generations. It carries a sense of heritage and connection to the rich French Canadian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian tradition, the name Pierrette holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the pearl of great price. Jesus tells a parable in Matthew 13:45-46 about a merchant in search of fine pearls who sells all he has to buy the precious pearl. Pierrette can be seen as a name for those who value and prioritize their spiritual growth above all else. It serves as a reminder to cherish the priceless treasure found in the grace of God and the love of Christ.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Pierrette: A pet form of Pierre, meaning "stone" or "rock" in French. Symbolically, it represents a strong and steadfast spirit, one who remains unwavering in faith and resilient in the face of adversity. Spiritually, it embodies the strength and stability of God, who is our solid foundation.
